# jtt projects

List the projects you can see, and what each one tracks.

![jtt projects](gifs/projects.gif)

```console
$ jtt projects
$ jtt projects --configured
```

`--configured` lists only the projects set up with [`jtt init`](init.md), from the settings,
without calling Jira. Projects not set up yet show "not configured"; the default project is
marked.
